headline: The sector in the cross hairs of the bond sell-off looks poised for a bounce, says Mike Khouw
detail: This suggests that despite the bond sell-off impacting tech, there might be a contrarian view for a bounce. This could offer a glimmer of hope for your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: While yields are a concern, this suggests potential for a rebound. Monitor your existing tech/chip holdings for signs of strength.

headline: Nvidia breaks through to new record highs. Plus, more good news for Boeing
detail: Nvidia's strength is a direct positive for the chip sector, a significant part of your portfolio. This could provide a tailwind for your chip-related holdings like SMH and MUU.
rec: This is good news for your chip exposure. Consider adding to SMH if it pulls back to the scanner entry (632.3-631.21, stop 628.93) to capitalize on sector strength.
